groups.name: A. min, max, count, find and reverse
B. unique, and searching sorted data

problems.title: maxsub
problems.tech: count the letters, then `max_element` finds the commonest; ties go to the earlier letter

problems.title: distance
problems.tech: remember where x and y were seen last; `min` keeps the closest

problems.title: uncommon
problems.tech: `reverse` the digits of each number, then compare the products

problems.title: cubes
problems.tech: the cubes go into a vector; `upper_bound` finds the largest that still fits

problems.title: monument
problems.tech: sort the positions; `lower_bound` counts how many are close

problems.title: sumpow
problems.tech: list every `2^b - 2^a`, then `sort` and `unique` before counting

problems.title: dates
problems.tech: the six orders of day, month and year come from `next_permutation`
